clock: the edit's clock: design/edit/EDL.json (17495 frames at 24 fps)
voice_ref: level_re_voice_db is dB under the narration's short-term loudness while it speaks (about -14 LUFS in a -14 LUFS master). Effects sit -11 to -24 dB under the voice; beds -22 to -36; the mixer may lift a hero cue it would bury (weight: hero).

air_floor.note: Under the whole film, including the total silences, so nothing is digitally dead.

music.note: Built from audio/score_plan.json once the score exists (not generated: waiting on the author's go for Lyria).

voice_note: Placed by audio/tools/mix.py from design/edit/EDL.json voice[] (each narration segment at its EDL start; a later line waits for the earlier one to end plus 0.2 s). The read is chosen with --voice (scratch now: audio/vo/scratch/lines.json and <chapter>_<nn>.wav).
duck_note: audio/tools/mix.py side-chains the score (8 dB) and the beds (3 dB) under the voice: lines closer than 0.8 s are one duck, 0.25 s look-ahead, 0.8 s release. Effects are not ducked (their levels are set re voice). Stop-downs (silences with "stop-down") beat ducking at the YES lines.
